reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Modeling the opposing agent—the browser runtime—requires anticipating its resource allocation strategies. When our primitives emit rapid state mutations, the browser may throttle event firing or collapse layout recalculations to preserve main-thread responsiveness.
